data.one_liner: Native C image editing for Flutter via FFI with filters and region-based effects.
data.what_it_does: FastImageEditor provides native C image processing for Flutter via Dart FFI. It supports blur, sepia, saturation, brightness, contrast, sharpen, and grayscale, including region-based effects and bicubic resizing.
use_when: You need to apply filters like blur, sepia, or sharpen to images natively
You need region-based or radial effects on images
You need high-performance batch processing or operation chains for images
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS
You only need simple image loading and caching
strengths: Native C performance via FFI avoiding Dart pixel loops
Includes batch processing and operation chains
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS documented)
Requires managing image bytes and handling formats directly

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Dart image processing library without native C FFI dependencies.
